integrity: The proof reduces subcode support to the intersection of an annihilator with the deleted m-space and the t exceptional vectors, then counts the minimizing subspaces by graph parametrizations. A standalone verifier exhausts every subspace for five ternary and quinary instances and reproduces both the minima and their multiplicities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the one-upper-element saturated family in Theorem 4.4. It counts subcodes attaining each generalized Hamming weight but does not determine the complete support-weight distribution. No novelty is claimed for the generalized Hamming-weight values, which follow more generally from the generalized Griesmer theorem.
title: Minimum-support subcode multiplicities in a new nonprojective Griesmer family
